title: A handle for CoreyAI
style: Future bass, hyperspeed energy, 150-160 BPM. High-pitched energetic kids vocals trading lines with Dad Corey (deeper, confident, slightly processed voice). Mum singing soft, warm backup vocals on choruses and emotional moments. Supersaw leads, wobbly aggressive bass, fast hi-hats, glitchy stutters, massive drops on choruses. Raw playful kid energy mixed with futuristic production. Keep it fun but emotional in the school section. 336 Hz sine wave subtly under the AI universe outro.
